text_blocks.snippet: Diarrhea can be a symptom of COVID-19 infection. It is typically a watery, loose stool that may occur frequently. Other gastrointestinal symptoms associated with COVID-19 include:
Nausea, Vomiting, Abdominal pain or cramping, Bloating, and Loss of appetite.

Diarrhea caused by COVID-19 usually occurs within a few days of infection and can last for several days. It is important to note that diarrhea can also be a symptom of other conditions, such as food poisoning or the flu. If you experience diarrhea along with other symptoms of COVID-19, such as fever, cough, or shortness of breath, it is recommended to seek medical attention.
